detail.ssh_enabled_label: Identify clients streaming through the DVR recording engine via SSH
detail.playback_failed_hint: Playback failed — this tuner may not support this playback mode. Try "{action}" instead.
detail.cancel_recording_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to cancel the recording rule for "{title}"? Upcoming airings will not be recorded.
detail.server_fallback_hint: HDHomeRun DVR requires a SiliconDust Series ID. If no match is found, this recording will automatically use the Built-in DVR.
detail.fallback_notification: Scheduled on Built-in DVR: "{title}" lacks a SiliconDust Series ID for HDHomeRun DVR.
detail.fallback_tooltip: Fell back to Built-in DVR because this program lacks a SiliconDust Series ID in the guide.
detail.fallback_confirm_message: "{title}" is outside the HDHomeRun guide window and lacks a SiliconDust Series ID. It will be scheduled on HDHomeRun Open's Built-in DVR instead.
detail.hdhomerun_dedup_note: HDHomeRun DVR tracks unique episodes in the cloud and skips repeats of previously recorded or broadcast episodes even when unchecked.
detail.retention_official_dvr_note: Managed by your HDHomeRun DVR subscription — episode retention isn't configurable here.
detail.not_connected_hint: No tuner configured yet — set up HDHomeRun in Settings.
detail.guide_unavailable_hint: Guide unavailable — showing channel lineup only. Program titles require an HDHomeRun DVR subscription.
detail.recording_in_progress_hint: Recording in progress — available to watch once finished.
detail.keyword_rule_keyword_hint: Comma-separated terms; matches if any term appears in the episode subtitle, description, or category. Leave blank to record every matching title.
detail.keyword_rule_builtin_only_note: Keyword and contains matching are powered by the Built-in DVR.
detail.server_transcode_hint: The backend runs ffmpeg to transcode the raw stream to H.264 so it plays in-app. Works with any tuner model, but adds real CPU load per viewer on whatever device is running the backend.
detail.hwaccel_device_hint: Which GPU node the VAAPI/Quick Sync presets use. Usually /dev/dri/renderD128, but a machine with a second graphics device shifts it to renderD129 — run the diagnostics below to see what is actually there.
detail.ffmpeg_debug_hint: Raises ffmpeg's own log level so hardware setup and filter details show up in the backend log. Worth turning on while diagnosing a failure, noisy the rest of the time.
detail.thumbnails_enabled_hint: Generates a hover-preview thumbnail sprite the first time a completed recording is opened, cached to disk after that. Turn off on machines where that one-time ffmpeg pass is too costly.
detail.diagnostics_hint: Checks each step in turn — device passthrough, permissions, driver, and a real test encode through every preset. Takes a few seconds and does not need a free tuner.
detail.diagnostics_no_dri: /dev/dri is not present, so the backend cannot reach a GPU at all. In Docker, add the /dev/dri device passthrough to the backend service.
detail.diagnostics_process: Backend runs as uid {uid}, gid {gid}, groups {groups}.
detail.external_only_hint: No in-app player — channels only offer a raw stream link to open in an external player like VLC.

network_settings.xmltv_hint: The standard guide format used by Plex, Channels DVR, TVheadend, etc. Channels are matched automatically by exact channel number against the feed's <channel> ids and display names.
network_settings.schedules_direct_hint: Non-profit metadata service providing rich listings data (Gracenote/TMS) via Schedules Direct JSON API.
network_settings.sd_no_active_lineups: No lineups configured on this account yet.
network_settings.tmdb_hint: Used to fetch show/movie poster art for recordings that don't already have artwork from your guide source.
network_settings.tmdb_get_key_link: Get a free TMDB API key
network_settings.tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
network_settings.ai_hint: Lets household members ask questions about the guide and propose scheduling or cancelling recordings in plain language. Nothing is ever changed without an explicit confirmation.
network_settings.ai_base_url_hint: Only needed for a custom or OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
network_settings.ai_fetch_models_error: Could not fetch models from the provider.
network_settings.ai_system_prompt_hint: Added to the built-in instructions — it can't remove the requirement that recording changes always need your confirmation.
network_settings.ai_enable_recording_tools_label: Let the assistant view recordings and propose scheduling or cancelling them
network_settings.channel_mapping_hint: Configure preferred guide source, Schedules Direct station mappings, and XMLTV mappings for channels.
network_settings.no_channels: No tuner channels discovered yet. Make sure your HDHomeRun tuner connection is configured above.
network_settings.guide_priority_hint: When channels use 'Default' guide source, listings will be pulled from the highest-priority provider that has data.
network_settings.dvr_priority_hint: When scheduling recordings with default settings, rules will be placed on the highest-priority available recording server.
network_settings.dvr_priority_error: Could not save recording server priority.
network_settings.dvr_provider_builtin_desc: Records directly to local storage using tuner streams with custom retention management.
network_settings.dvr_provider_hdhomerun_desc: SiliconDust official DVR engine on the local network.
